summary: remaining_for eagerly computes n + k, which can overflow before saturating_sub or checked_binomial handles it, causing a debug panic or incorrect wrapped size hints. The fix handles n == 0 separately and computes (n - 1).checked_add(k), returning None on overflow while preserving representable n + k - 1 values. Blocked: the fix adds no tests, and no detecting upstream test was found at this revision. combinations_with_replacement_range_count only covers n and k through 7; other existing tests do not exercise this overflow. No tests were run.

reversal.parent_text: let count = |n: usize, k: usize| checked_binomial((n + k).saturating_sub(1), k);
